scope: v5 private adapters and prepared final4 wholecheck launcher; no product changes

findings.issue: API pool overrides are inherited by Go test processes, changing tests that require DATABASE_MAX_CONNS / DATABASE_MIN_CONNS to be unset.
findings.evidence: verification.json api_pool_contamination_proof: both test-owned fake package children inherit 10 / 1. The real path scripts/check.sh -> scripts/test-go.sh -> agent-CLI guard strips neither key.
findings.required_fix: Separate API launch pool settings from all Go test subprocess environments, including recursive calls; add a no-DB environment contract. Preserve API 10/1 and the original pool-sizing assertions.

findings.issue: The private launcher loads check-source.env by sourcing shell code, contrary to the explicit dotenv parsing contract.
findings.evidence: verification.json dotenv_evaluation_proof: the identical loader executes a harmless command substitution in a reviewer-owned fixture. The actual private env was not executed and no malicious contents are asserted.
findings.required_fix: Parse the controlled dotenv file without shell evaluation; reject unsupported shell constructs and preserve literals according to the existing dotenv contract. Add a no-network, no-DB literal/command-substitution regression.
